annotations.title: Check that PitchSpark pitch search is up

description: Check that PitchSpark's startup pitch service is answering before relying on it, and which API version it speaks. Use when: you only need to know whether the service is available. Do not use for: finding startups or reading pitches; it returns no pitch data. Returns {"status":"ok","version":"1.0"}. No API key is needed, even when the server requires one for the other tools. It uses none of the daily pitch allowance and none of the other tools' per-minute limits: health has its own per-connection call limit, and the call is logged. Read-only: does not change your data or any pitch content. Requests are logged, and each pitch returned is counted as a view. Opening a returned pitch link can add one spark to the pitch's public spark count (once per viewer, updated hourly). Pitch search is pitchspark_search_pitches_v1.
name: pitchspark_get_health_v1

error.description: Present only when the call failed (isError true).

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. RATE_LIMITED, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, PITCH_LIMIT_REACHED, INTERNAL.

message.description: A short human-readable explanation, safe to show the user. Never a stack trace.

retry_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when waiting helps.

retryable.description: true when the same call can succeed later without changes.

title: Check that PitchSpark pitch search is up
